top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children's files were missing emergency contact addresses.

top_violation_types.title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: It was determined caregiver does not have high school diploma or high school equivalent certificate.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: RE-CITE: Staff needs to update the expired first aid and CPR training. Expired on April 2020.

top_violation_types.title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There were four classrooms being used during inspection.  In the infant classroom, the activity plan did not have the date.  In a second classroom, the activity plan was not for the current week.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver would step out of the room to go to the kitchen and leave infants unsupervised.
